{{Quote|Protect us from the enemies that beset our empire, Naga Sadow!|The Sith Councilor|<ref name="TGAotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>}}
A '''Sith Lord''' of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as a member of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Sith Council|ruling council]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. When their fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Simus]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in what the Sith Council assumed to have been a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|attack]], the Councilor expressed their outrage at the supposed perpetrators. Later, the Councilor participated in a private ceremony where the newly elected [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], was branded with the [[Mark of Dark Lord of the Sith|emblem]] of the Dark Lords. When Sadow subsequently summoned the Sith Lords of the empire during the preparations for the upcoming invasion of the Republic, the Councilor was among the Lords that gathered at Sadow's [[Naga Sadow's Khar Delba citadel|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khar Delba]].

==Biography==
===An attack on the Sith Empire===
{{Quote|They've killed old Simus!''"<br />"''They are monsters.|Dor Gal-ram and the Sith Councilor|<ref name="TGAotS3" />}}
[[File:SimusDeathAnnouncement-TGAotS3.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Sith Councilor was outraged at the news of Simus's murder.]]
A [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who ruled over a dozen [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] served as a member of its [[Sith Council]]<ref name="TGAotS3" /> by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] arrived in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]], the Sith Councilor's fellow Sith Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] plotted to use their arrival to force the Sith Empire into a new phase of expansion via an invasion of the Republic. To that end, Sadow violently [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|liberated]] the Daragon siblings from their [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], in the process planting as evidence Republic [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and [[Death/Legends|murdering]] [[Simus]]&mdash;his former [[Sith Master/Legends|mentor]] who had survived a long-ago [[Duel between Marka Ragnos and Simus|decapitation]] in the form of a disembodied head.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

Sadow's actions led the Sith Council to believe the Daragons were Republic [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and that their liberation was a precursor to a Republic invasion of the Sith Empire. When, during a session of the Council held in Ziost's [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]], the Sith Lord<ref name="TGAotS3" /> [[Dor Gal-ram]]<ref name="TGAotS4" /> revealed that Simus had been murdered,<ref name="TGAotS3" /> his<ref name="CSWE Gal-ram">{{CSWECite|I|317|Gal-Ram, Dor}}</ref> fellow Councilor expressed their outrage at the actions of the perpetrator&mdash;believed by the Council to have been Republic agents.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

===A new Dark Lord and war preparations===
{{Quote|We have been too long without a Dark Lord of the Sith&hellip;|The Sith Councilor|<ref name="TGAotS3" />}}
Sadow subsequently feigned shock at Simus's death and, in a speech delivered to the Sith Council, used the recent events as an argument for both crowning him as the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the empire and launching a conquest of the Republic. Being a part of the majority of the councilmembers that expressed its support for Sadow's candidature, the Sith Councilor affirmed the urgent necessity for the election of a new leader for the empire. After Sadow's rival, [[Ludo Kressh]], and [[Ludo Kressh's faction|his supporters]] stormed out of the Council chamber in protest over Sadow's election, the Sith Councilor and their remaining peers all bowed to Sadow as their new Dark Lord. Meanwhile, Sadow instructed all of them to rally their [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for an upcoming invasion of the Republic.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

[[File:SithCouncilorCrystalVessel-TGAotS4.jpg|thumb|left|295px|The Sith Councilor during Naga Sadow's coronation ceremony]]
Later, the Sith Councilor and<ref name="TGAotS4" /> [[Unidentified Sith Councilor (Sith arthropods)|one]] of their fellow councilmembers<ref name="TGAotS3" /> took part in the private ceremony of Sadow receiving the [[mark of Dark Lord of the Sith]]. During the ritual, the Councilor held a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] vessel containing a pair of [[Sith pincerbug|arthropods]]. Their colleague then took the container and released the [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]] on Sadow's forehead, where the creatures burned the emblem of the Dark Lords into the new Sith ruler's skin. At the conclusion of the ceremony, both of the Sith Lords performing the ritual bowed to Sadow, with the Sith Councilor imploring that the Dark Lord act toward the protection of the Sith Empire from its enemies.<ref name="TGAotS4" />

The Sith Lords loyal to Sadow engaged in the construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for the upcoming offensive. After Sadow's forces [[Battle of Khar Delba|crippled]] the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of Kressh and his supporters, the Dark Lord ordered his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] followers to rally all the loyalist Lords<ref name="TGAotS5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> to his [[Naga Sadow's Khar Delba citadel|fortress]] on<ref name="TFotSE1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref> the planet [[Khar Delba]].<ref name="TGAotS5" /> The Sith Councilor was among the [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] that arrived soon thereafter, kneeling to Sadow upon arrival. The Sith Lords then attended a meeting with Sadow concerning the planned invasion of the Republic, after which the Lords' fleets were summoned<ref name="TFotSE1" /> to the [[Khar Delba system/Legends|Khar Delba system]]. From there, the [[Sith invasion fleet]] subsequently launched its [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|attack]] on the Republic.<ref name="TFotSE2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 2]]</ref> The Republic ultimately thwarted the Sith Empire's attempt at conquest<ref name="TGAotS5" /> and in return launched a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of Sith Space that eventually saw the decimation of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire and a member of the empire's Sith Council, the Sith Councilor was loyal to the Dark Lord of the Sith. They also held the long-lived fellow Sith Lord Simus in great esteem. The Sith Councilor was a member of the Sith species. They had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] which they wore in a ponytail, and a long brown beard. The Councilor had on their forehead a black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] depicting an abstract symbol.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

==Equipment==
The Sith Councilor wore blue<ref name="TGAotS3" /> or brown [[Robe/Legends|robes]]<ref name="TFotSE1" /> with bulky upper-torso [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="TGAotS3" /> complemented by a metallic [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and armored [[Limb/Legends|knee]]-pads.<ref name="TFotSE1" /> They also wore a metallic headdress and a pair of ornamental [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], both inlaid with [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]].<ref name="TGAotS4" /> The Councilor's beard was decorated with a small [[Bone/Legends|bone]], and they were equipped with a [[Sith sword]] with a jagged blade.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Councilor first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|third issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]],<ref name="TGAotS3" /> and published on [[December 11]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54592/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_3|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #3}}</ref>
